map.规划您的旅行开支，让旅途更安心: Plan your travel spending so the trip feels more secure
map.旅行总预算 = 交通 + 住宿（每晚房价 × 晚数）+ 餐饮（每人每天 × 人数: Total trip budget = transport + accommodation (nightly rate × nights) + food (per person per day × people × days) + tickets + shopping + contingency; per person = total ÷ people. Contingency is usually reserved at 10% to 15% of the total, and an overspending risk is flagged when actual spending exceeds the total or a single item exceeds 120% of its budget.
map.交通 3000＋住宿 400×5=2000＋餐饮 150×5=750＋门票 80: Transport 3000 + accommodation 400×5 = 2000 + food 150×5 = 750 + tickets 800 + shopping 1000 + contingency 500 = CNY 8050; that is CNY 4025 per person and CNY 805 per day. Food accounts for 750 ÷ 8050 ≈ 9.3%.
map.购物改 3000 后总 10050，饼图实时变；可看哪项超支再减。: Changing shopping to 3000 brings the total to 10050 and the pie chart updates live, so you can see which category is over budget and trim it.
map.餐饮含人数吗？: Does the food cost already account for the number of people?
map.餐饮按「每人每天×天数」算，不重复乘人数；交通/住宿等多为整笔。: Food is computed as cost per person per day × days and is not multiplied by the head count again; transport and accommodation are usually a single lump sum.
map.六项各算 v÷total×100: Each of the six categories is computed as value ÷ total × 100
